items.title: Luis Conte interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 24, 2025
items.q: oh yeah you just toured with Madonna, great.

ctx.x: You know people who aspire to this life they may not know that it’s partly gone, but I think they’re probably envious of what you and these other fellas you’ve mentioned do. Is there any downside or challenges that you’ve had to deal with with this life? Which is in the studios a lot but also then touring and so forth?

Well I mean it’s not an easy life man. The famous line is like you’re as good as your last phone call. That’s the real world. I mean I’ve done huge tours and you come home and © Fillius Jazz Archive -14-

you’ve got to keep working so you’ve got to wait for the phone to ring, so you’re as good as – well if the phone doesn’t ring well oh yeah you just toured with Madonna, great. What have you been doing the last three months? “I’ve been doing nothing.” That wasn’t the case but it’s not an easy life. And the other side of that, the road thing, the session thing you just don’t say no first of all. You don’t say no to any gigs man. That’s my philosophy. I don’t say no. If I’m free I’ll be there. Then you go on tour…
